heroLead: Voyager Maps has 11,994 practical places mapped in Berlin — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.

ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Berlin on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Berlin
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Berlin it currently holds 839 public toilets and 414 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Berlin has 2.0 times more public toilets than places to refill a bottle — 839 against 414. Worth filling up before you set out.
